raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (ingested 2026-01-17) carries txn_ts in DD/MM/YYYY format (e.g. '16/01/2026 06:00:11'), while all other rows are ISO, so the unconditional CAST fails. Batch timing and the day value 16 (which cannot be a month) show these are day-first timestamps for 2026-01-16, so parsing slash-format values as %d/%m/%Y fixes the cast without changing other rows.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN txn_ts LIKE '__/__/____ __:__:__' THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN txn_ts LIKE '__/__/____ __:__:__' THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
